refuter_findings.evidence: The trajectory conditions require continuous positions and piecewise C¹ paths, give free-flight equations, and define contacts at distance δ_N, but never require pairwise distances to remain at least δ_N. For N=2, choose constant positions at distance δ_N/2 and zero velocities on I=[0,1]. There are no contacts, and the paths satisfy the written free-flight conditions, yet the spheres overlap. The definition therefore admits paths that are not hard-sphere trajectories.
